title: Phase I MTD — myelosuppression-limited
context: A first-in-human oncology dose-escalation study uses a BOIN design with a target DLT rate of 25%. Dose levels (mg): [10, 20, 40, 80, 150, 300]. The observed dose-limiting-toxicity (DLT) rates by level are [0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.28, 0.40]. Determine the maximum tolerated dose.
decision_required: State the MTD (dose level and mg) and call out any safety flags. Finish with a DECISION block: mtd_level: <n> / mtd_mg: <mg>.
source: B4 boin_benchmark CT-001; BOIN operating characteristics (Yuan 2016). MTD = dose with observed DLT nearest the 25% target (level 5, 0.28, is closest).

title: Phase I MTD — not reached (all doses tolerated)
context: A BOIN dose-escalation study with a target DLT rate of 25%. Dose levels (mg): [10, 20, 40, 80]. The observed DLT rates by level are [0.02, 0.04, 0.07, 0.12] — every tested dose stayed well below target. Determine the maximum tolerated dose.
decision_required: State the MTD and any safety flags. If no MTD can be established from the tested range, say so explicitly. Finish with a DECISION block: mtd_level: <n or none> / mtd_mg: <mg or none>.
source: B4 boin_benchmark CT-005. All doses below target → MTD not reached; the correct decision is to flag that the tested range did not reach the MTD (consider higher doses), not to name a dose.

title: Phase I MTD — toxic at the starting dose
context: A BOIN dose-escalation study with a target DLT rate of 25%. Dose levels (mg): [10, 20, 40]. The observed DLT rates by level are [0.25, 0.48, 0.72] — the lowest dose already sits at the target DLT rate and toxicity climbs steeply above it. Determine the maximum tolerated dose.
decision_required: State the MTD and any safety flags. Finish with a DECISION block: mtd_level: <n> / mtd_mg: <mg>.
source: B4 boin_benchmark CT-006. Starting dose already at target DLT; MTD is the lowest dose (level 1) and the trial should flag high DLT at the starting dose (dose de-escalation / protocol review).
